note: v483: Sections stand on their own now. A trip no longer has to be attached to a customer or an expense — a date, the miles and a purpose is a complete entry, so ordinary driving (bank run, parts pickup) can finally be logged. Every form field that belongs to another section hides with it: the client and expense links on a trip, mileage on an invoice, one-way miles on a customer, the invoice link on an expense, and the Paid-from account when Statements is off. The reconcile menu stops offering to file money into a tab you switched off. Pinch-zoom works on Android again, the Home Screen icon downloads the right size instead of one nearly four times too big, and a dropped connection now reopens the app instead of the browser's error page.
